narr: A midlevel shortwave trough trekked across the Northern Rockies beneath a weakening ridge. This feature tapped into the already present monsoonal moisture to produce scattered to numerous showers and thunderstorms. Some storms produced heavy rain which led to localized flash flooding across portions of Grand County in east-central Utah.
ev: An NWS storm survey found evidence of a major flash flooding event in the Westwater Drainage Valley. Water was estimated to be 6 to up to 12 feet deep based on erosion of the arroyo walls. Numerous instances of dry arroyo crossings were washed out with significant transport of sediment and debris downvalley.
